name: theme-winui
title: Theme: WinUI 3
description: WinUI 3 (Windows 11 / Fluent 2) palette and metrics as one more theme — WinUI fill/stroke tokens, 4/8 px circular corners, Segoe UI Variable, Consolas, double focus ring, timing motion, underline tabs/fields, and Windows blur material — installed into themes/winui/ (theme.json, semantics.json, light.tokens.json, dark.tokens.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.
